{{Quote|It was Imperial Transport who brought you there, Imperial Supply who arranged and provisioned that house for you, and Imperial Engineering who built the camouflaged island landing site for your use.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial Transport''' was an organization within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] responsible for movement of [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] equipment and personnel.

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], they transported the [[Joruus C'baoth|clone]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] to his house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jomark/Legends|Jomark]] under orders from [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].
